research_mode: official UK government and ONS primary statistical releases and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: Police workforce release scope
verified_claims: The release reports police workers in the 43 territorial forces and provides BTP data in accompanying tables.
limitations: Many England-and-Wales headline analyses exclude BTP.

sources.name: Police workforce FTE convention
verified_claims: Workforce figures are presented in full-time equivalents unless otherwise stated, with headcount equivalents in tables.
limitations: FTE and headcount must not be mixed.

sources.name: Total paid police workforce
verified_claims: The paid police workforce was 234,441 FTE at 31 March 2026, down 0.6% from a year earlier.
limitations: A workforce stock is not a direct measure of local service performance.

sources.name: Police officer total
verified_claims: There were 145,886 FTE police officers, 566 fewer than a year earlier.
limitations: National officer totals do not establish staffing at a parcel.

sources.name: Police staff total
verified_claims: Police staff and designated officers totalled 81,296 FTE, 710 fewer than a year earlier.
limitations: The combined category cannot be split where forces cannot report designated officers separately.

sources.name: PCSO total
verified_claims: There were 7,259 FTE PCSOs, 55 fewer than a year earlier.
limitations: PCSO numbers are not equivalent to police officer numbers.

sources.name: Special constable total
verified_claims: There were 5,196 special constables on a headcount basis, down 324.
limitations: Special constables lack contracted hours, so headcount is not FTE capacity.

sources.name: Police support volunteer total
verified_claims: There were 6,035 police support volunteers on a headcount basis, up 26.
limitations: Volunteer headcount does not quantify hours contributed.

sources.name: OPCC exclusion
verified_claims: People working in or for offices of police and crime commissioners are excluded from force workforce figures.
limitations: OPCC staff must not be added to force totals without separate definitions.

sources.name: Workforce revision boundary
verified_claims: Forces submitted routine revisions to earlier workforce periods and the current tables supersede older releases.
limitations: Archived bulletin values may not equal the latest open-data values.

sources.name: BTP exclusion in headline trend
verified_claims: Headline territorial-force trend tables exclude British Transport Police.
limitations: BTP must be handled separately in force comparisons.

sources.name: Staff and designated-officer combination
verified_claims: Police staff and designated officers are combined because some forces cannot report designated officers separately.
limitations: The combined figure cannot support a precise designated-officer count.

sources.name: Headcount-only worker types
verified_claims: Special constables and police support volunteers are reported as headcount because they do not have contracted working hours.
limitations: Their counts should not be summed with FTE totals as equivalent units.

sources.name: Officer peak comparison
verified_claims: Police officer FTE was 1.3% below the March 2024 peak.
limitations: Peak comparison does not describe every force's trajectory.

sources.name: Workforce publication frequency
verified_claims: The workforce series reports March and September snapshots.
limitations: Snapshot dates do not measure daily staffing variation.

sources.name: Neighbourhood policing growth
verified_claims: Neighbourhood policing personnel increased by 3,814 FTE, or 22.2%, above the March 2025 baseline.
limitations: The growth measure includes defined categories and is not a parcel-deployment count.

sources.name: Neighbourhood training inclusion
verified_claims: The neighbourhood-policing total includes 472 FTE personnel in training destined for neighbourhood roles.
limitations: Personnel in training are not yet fully deployed in those roles.

sources.name: Neighbourhood exclusions
verified_claims: Neighbourhood growth figures exclude employees on long-term absence and exclude BTP.
limitations: Comparisons require the same exclusions.

sources.name: Neighbourhood snapshot boundary
verified_claims: The reported neighbourhood increase is a net snapshot and the individuals contributing can change through joins, exits and transfers.
limitations: The growth figure does not identify a fixed cohort.

sources.name: Female officer share
verified_claims: There were 53,712 FTE female police officers, representing 36.8% of officers in territorial forces.
limitations: The percentage excludes cases with unstated sex and excludes BTP.
